title: Practice 17: In an hour, a week ago, for two days

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Я пеку пирог на ___ (день) рождения Мэри.
exercises.prompt: I'm baking a cake for Mary's birthday.
exercises.why: The preposition на + acc. is used to indicate the length of time one expects to stay some place, or the time something is expected to last: *Он приехал сюда на два дня. Я получил отпуск на неделю.* Note also: на следующий день — next day. The preposition за + acc. denotes the time that it takes to accomplish an action: *Он сделает это за неделю. Я прочитал эту книгу за два дня.* «за + acc.» is also used in combination with «до + gen.» to denote the time of one event taking place before some other event: *Он умер за год до войны. — From the DLI Grammar Reference Book. Lessons 73, 77.  ·  «The preposition НА + Acc. is used to indicate the length of time one expects to stay some place, or the time something is expected to last.» — DLI, Lesson 73.
exercises.context: The preposition на + acc. (From the DLI Grammar Reference Book. Lessons 73, 77)
